rows.grounds: bahuvrihi adjective describing the practitioner as fasting; nominative singular masculine
instrument expressing the manner of worship
prescriptive optative enjoining the ritual act
instrument indicating conformity to prescribed ritual method

items.question: What fasting and ritual discipline is required for proper worship of the sun?
premises: The practitioner must remain without food.
The sun is the designated object of worship.
Worship must be performed with devotion.
Worship must follow the prescribed ritual rule.
items.inference: Proper solar worship requires fasting combined with devoted observance of the prescribed ritual method.
uncertainties: The vocative nṛpa may address a literal king or serve as a conventional address to the practitioner.
items.plain_english: O king, while fasting, one should worship the sun with devotion according to the prescribed rule.
